summary: Unpinned github: dependency on third-party repo default branch
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:tenka-san/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA or tag. On `npm install`, npm resolves the current default-branch tip of that third-party GitHub repository and installs whatever it returns, including any lifecycle scripts contained in that tarball. The referenced repository belongs to an account (`tenka-san`) unrelated to this package's publisher scope (`@poucode`), so whoever controls that external repository controls code executed on every installer of this package. Because the source is a mutable branch rather than a registry version or pinned commit, the content delivered at install time can change at any moment without any new release of this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
